title: Global Change Coordinator
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll work closely with our clients and internal teams to ensure that services are restored swiftly, in line with our service level agreements (SLAs).
  
  
Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go-to person for second-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.
  
  
You'll proactively monitor work queues, execute operational tasks, and update tickets with the actions you've taken. Identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate will be a key part of your role. You'll communicate with other teams and clients to provide support and ensure that changes are executed with clear risk identification and mitigation plans.
  
  
As part of the shift handover process, you'll highlight key tickets and upcoming critical tasks for the next shift. When needed, you'll escalate tickets to ensure the right focus from our Centres of Excellence (CoE) and other teams. Collaborating with our automation teams, you'll work on optimizing efforts and automating routine tasks, all while coaching our Service desk and L1 teams in both technical and behavioural skills.
  
  
You'll also establish monitoring for client infrastructure, leading and managing initial client escalations for operational issues. Contributing to the change management process, you'll log change requests, execute approved maintenance activities, and audit incident and request tickets for quality. Your insights will drive trend analysis reports, identifying tasks suitable for automation to reduce tickets and optimize efforts. You might also support disaster recovery functions and other related tasks as needed.
  
  
**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Proficiency in technologies such as Pulse Secure SSL VPN, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco Nexus switches/routers/firewalls, and more familiarity with ticketing tools.
* At least one technical certification in the above-mentioned technologies.
* Strong planning skills, with the ability to anticipate and adapt to changing circumstances.
* Adaptability and resilience in a dynamic work environment.
* Ability to communicate and work effectively across different cultures and social groups.
* Proficiency in active listening and client-centric communication.

Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). In this role, your duties range from the physical deployment of DC related technology to working closely with various stakeholders. It will fall on you to ensure that our goals, missions and projects are successfully delivered, and, more importantly, that they are repeatable across our global array of DCs. Built on a cloud-native architecture, the platform leverages the Snowflake Data Cloud for unparalleled scalability and performance.
  
  
Securonix is proud to be a cybersecurity unicorn and featured in CRN's 2024 Security 100 list. Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the largest private equity firms with over $100 billion in assets under management, we have a unique advantage in driving innovation and growth. worldwide, including 10% of the Fortune 100. Our network of 150+ partners and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) enables us to deliver unmatched security solutions on a global scale.

**Role Summary**
The Senior SIEM Consultant position is an integral part of our Professional Services team. In this role, you will work with our customers , supporting our mission to help them quickly and completely adopt our Security Operating Platform, leaving them more secure. This is a highly technical, hands-on role that will focus on architecting, planning, implementing, and operationalizing the SIEM platform. * Training and enabling customers and partners for successful adoption.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 8+ years of experience in information security and SIEM field.
* Strong understanding of SIEM solutions such as Splunk, Qradar, ArcSight, Logrhythm and Exabeam.
* Experience deploying SIEM acorss multiple customers.
* Good understanding of MITRE ATT&CK matrices, kill chains and other attack models.
* Strong communication skills and customer facing experience.
* Strong knowledge of scripting languages such as Python, Powershell.
* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM

**Preferred**

* Working knowledge of Machine learning in cybersecurity
* Working knowledge of cloud technologies such as Amazon, Azure and Google
* Good understanding of log collection methodologies and aggregation techniques such as Syslog-NG, syslog, Nxlog, Windows Event Forwarding
* Good understanding of Hadoop ecosystem and Apache technologies.
* Experience integrating endpoint security and host-based intrusion detection solutions

description:

**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Security Remote Field Service Engineer (L1) is an entry level engineering role, operating in region and is responsible for providing a professional remote technical support service to clients by identifying and resolving technical incidents and problems.
  
  
Through pre-emptive service incident and resolution activities, this role will restore service to clients by driving incidents to an effective resolution and ensuring all requests, process events and resolution incidents result in zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Maintains the support process and ensures that requests for support are handled according to the procedures.
* Uses service assurance software and tools to investigate and diagnose problems, collects performance statistics and creates reports, working with users, other staff and suppliers as appropriate.
* Identifies and resolves problems following agreed procedures.
* Carries out agreed maintenance tasks.
* Ensures usage of knowledge articles in incident diagnosis and resolution and assist with updating as and when required.
* Performs defined tasks to monitor service delivery against service level agreements and maintains records of relevant information.
* Analyses service records against agreed service levels regularly to identify actions required to maintain or improve levels of service, and initiates or reports these actions.
* Prioritises and diagnoses incidents according to agreed procedures.
* Investigates causes of incidents and seeks resolution.
* Escalates unresolved incidents and follows up until incident is resolved.
* Provides service recovery, following resolution of incidents.
* Documents and closes resolved incidents according to agreed procedures.
* Maintains secure, accurate, complete, and current configuration on configuration items (CIs).
* Applies tools, techniques and processes to track, log and correct information related to CIs, ensuring protection of assets and components from unauthorized change, diversion, and inappropriate use.
* Remotely investigates and identifies root cause of incidents and assist with the implementation of agreed remedies and preventative measures.
* Maintains knowledge of specific specialisms, provides detailed advice regarding their application.
* Ensures efficient and comprehensive resolution of incidents, including ensuring that repairs are carried out by coordinating product requests, working with other team members.

title: High Touch Engineer (HTE) / NCE - Routing & Switching / Data Center| BFSI DOMAIN
description:
High Touch Engineer (HTE) / Network Consulting Engineer - Routing & Switching / Data Center
  
  
Position Overview
  
  

* Role Title: High Touch Engineer / Senior Network Consulting Engineer - Routing, Switching & DC
* Work Location: Client Onsite - National Stock Exchange (NSE),BKC Mumbai
* Working Model: Onsite (Rotational Morning/Afternoon shifts; 24x7 readiness with Night shifts during approved Maintenance Windows)
* Experience Level: 8-15 Years

Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced, customer-facing High Touch Engineer (HTE) to lead incident management, network architecture compliance, and complex maintenance window execution for mission-critical Data Center and enterprise campus networks. The candidate will drive proactive network lifecycle management, ensure adherence to Cisco Gold Standards, and serve as the primary technical lead for high-severity network events.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Incident & Escalation Leadership: Lead real-time troubleshooting for critical P1/P2 incidents, coordinate root cause analysis (RCA), and interface with Cisco TAC and internal architecture teams.
* Change Execution & Maintenance: Author Methods of Procedure (MoPs), lead approved change windows, and execute complex migrations and upgrades during night maintenance windows.
* Proactive Life-Cycle Services: Conduct software bug scrubs, PSIRT security advisory audits, hardware/software end-of-life reviews, and device health audits.
* Configuration Compliance & Hardening: Audit network nodes against hardening benchmarks, eliminate configuration drift, and ensure continuous baseline compliance.
* Best Practice Implementation: Benchmark and optimize live configurations against Cisco Validated Designs (CVD) across routing, switching, timing, and multicast architectures.

**Required Technical Skills & Expertise**

* Routing & Protocols: Deep hands-on mastery of OSPF, BGP (eBGP/iBGP/MP-BGP EVPN), route redistribution, route-maps, prefix-lists, and path selection tuning.
* Data Center & Switching Technologies: Advanced expertise in vPC (virtual Port-Channel), Spanning Tree Protocols (STP / Rapid-PVST / MST), VLAN segmentation, LACP, and VXLAN EVPN fabrics.
* Timing & Network Synchronization: Practical configuration and troubleshooting of Precision Time Protocol (PTP / IEEE 1588v2) and Network Time Protocol (NTP) in high-frequency trading / financial environments.
* Hardware Platforms: Extensive experience managing, upgrading, and troubleshooting:
* Cisco Nexus Series: N9000,N3000 (NX-OS)

title: Consultant - OT Data Operations Engineering
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The GIC Supply Chain team manages end-to-end operations, encompassing planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and analytics. They strategically plan to meet market demands, optimize sourcing, ensure efficient production, and oversee the seamless movement of goods from production to delivery. The team employs advanced analytics throughout these processes, fostering adaptability and operational excellence. This collaborative approach ensures a well-coordinated supply chain that aligns with both organizational goals and dynamic market conditions. This role requires you to operate in 1.30 pm to 10.30 pm.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Design, configure, and deploy Ignition-based OT Data Operations gateways at the manufacturing edge, including virtual machines, Windows Server environments, plant networks, drivers, tags, MQTT brokers, historians, and security roles.
* Implement and standardize sensor-to-signal workflows from PLC/SCADA connectivity through calculations and contextualization into MES and analytics platforms.
* Collaborate with MES engineers, solution architects, and site controls engineers to ensure smooth integration of the OT Data Operations layer with TrakSYS MES, existing MQIS capabilities, and future MOM solutions.
* Apply and maintain ISA-95-aligned data models for assets, materials, orders, and events, ensuring consistency across plants and use cases.
* Partner with IT integration teams to design scalable and supportable integration patterns between OT systems, SAP, PLM, and enterprise analytics platforms.
* Support the configuration, performance, and storage strategy of time-series databases, including SQL Server historian, QuestDB, and future platforms.
* Define and implement monitoring, alerting, security controls, and operational runbooks for Ignition gateways, MQTT brokers, and associated infrastructure across pilot and production sites.
* Support site rollout activities including lab validation, plant commissioning, troubleshooting, infrastructure sizing, and continuous improvement of deployment patterns.
* Develop and maintain documentation, standards, playbooks, and training materials in partnership with Digital Controls & IS, Digital Core, plant engineering, and vendor teams to enable scalable deployment and local support.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, or IT Engineering from an accredited university.
* Experience: 10+ years of experience in Controls Engineering, Manufacturing Systems Engineering, and Data Analytics, including 5+ years of relevant experience in OT Data Operations on Ignition.
* Technical Skills: Strong experience in OT/industrial automation engineering, including PLC/SCADA, historians, industrial networks, and manufacturing data integration/MES implementation.
* Platform Expertise: Direct hands-on experience with Inductive Automation Ignition, including gateway configuration, tag historian, alarming, MQTT modules, security/SSO, Perspective, and Jython scripting.
* Data & Integration Knowledge: Knowledge of ISA-95 modeling concepts, Unified Namespace (UNS), asset hierarchy, and OT-to-IT integration architecture.
* System & Connectivity Skills: Hands-on experience with PLC/SCADA connectivity, protocols such as OPC-UA, Modbus, vendor-specific drivers, scripting/configuration using Python, SQL, and Ignition scripting, and Windows/Linux server environments with virtualization.
* Analytical & Technical Capability: Experience with time-series databases/historians, IIoT and MQTT broker technologies, and the ability to read and interpret P&IDs, control narratives, and plant network diagrams.
* Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and written/verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical architectures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Industry Experience: Experience working in regulated or highly controlled environments such as food manufacturing, pharma, or CPG

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to MES platforms such as TrakSYS or similar, and integration patterns with SAP or other enterprise systems
* GCP certification
* Background in Mathematics or Statistics

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

They will also be responsible for engaging with external vendors to remediate hardware and software issues, and participate in project related work such as network device upgrades and capacity augmentations. An ideal candidate will possess a wide range of skills, including alert monitoring & resolution in large-scale networks and CSP environments, outstanding troubleshooting skills, understanding of L3 underlay networks, and network protocol knowledge in large multi-vendor infrastructures.

* Engage in 24/7 global shift rotations to provide remote support for network repairs and changes while collaborating across teams and updating customers on status and ticket information.
* Drive operational improvements in change management and daily operations by following procedures.
* Manage and operate large scale IP network technologies and infrastructures.
* Utilise your skills in Peering and Datacenter interconnect technologies: PNI, Transit, Exchange, Passive DWDM, Wave circuits.
* Monitor and support the network health of on-premises and cloud infrastructures.
* Collaborate and develop workflow enhancements while documenting best practices.

**What We Need To See**

* Deep knowledge and experience of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IS-IS, VxLAN, EVPN, QoS, GRE, IPsec, DNS, and MACsec.
* Over 4 years of experience in network operations.
* Skilled in network troubleshooting techniques and leveraging creative problem-solving abilities.
* Strong track record of alert response within defined SLAs and Incident management.
* Experience with one or more of the following CSP environments: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
* Familiarity with Arista, Fortinet and Juniper.
* Hands-on experience with contributing to tooling and automation for provisioning, monitoring, and managing complex network infrastructures.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: Sr. Infrastructure Engineer – eApps
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**

* Lead the engineering, operation, and continuous improvement of infrastructure supporting third-party Enterprise Applications (E-Apps), with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as the primary cloud environment.
* Own hands-on infrastructure engineering across cloud and hybrid environments, including secure design, provisioning, migration, deployment, capacity, reliability, and lifecycle management.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform as the primary tool, supported by Ansible, Python, and Shell scripting; use PowerShell where required for Windows administration.
* Partner with solution teams, Enterprise Applications stakeholders, security, network, and service teams to define hosting standards, technical specifications, operational readiness, and support models.
* Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and promote standardization, observability, ITSM discipline, and secure-by-design practices across the E-Apps platform.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Operate and continuously improve the E-Apps infrastructure estate, including availability, performance, capacity, resilience, disaster recovery, patching, upgrades, and platform lifecycle management.
* Design and provision GCP infrastructure using approved architecture and security patterns across compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, certificates, logging, monitoring, storage, and secrets management.
* Build reusable Terraform modules and deployment patterns and develop Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell scripts to eliminate manual work and improve deployment consistency.
* Administer and troubleshoot web and application platforms including IIS, JBoss, and Apache, with understanding of Java application hosting, reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS offload, certificates, ports, and application integrations.
* Implement observability and operational insight using Datadog and GCP monitoring/logging capabilities, including dashboards, metrics, logs, traces, alerting, health checks, service-level indicators, and actionable runbooks.
* Apply ITSM practices across incident, problem, change, service request, knowledge, and major-incident management; maintain accurate operational documentation and participate in governance and change reviews.
* Act as a senior escalation point for outages, complex incidents, root-cause analysis, vendor coordination, security findings, and recovery activities; drive permanent corrective actions.
* Establish standards and governance for configuration, access, automation, monitoring, vulnerability remediation, backup, recovery, and operational readiness of new and existing applications.
* Mentor team members and coordinate support coverage while promoting knowledge sharing, effective handoffs, and continuous improvement across the platform team.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Full-time bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.
* Experience: 8–12 years of experience designing, implementing, operating, and supporting complex infrastructure and enterprise application environments, including high-availability and mission-critical systems.
* GCP — primary requirement: Strong hands-on experience with GCP services and architecture, including Compute Engine, VPC networking, IAM, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud DNS, SSL certificates, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Secret Manager, storage, and hybrid connectivity.
* Terraform — primary engineering keyword: Demonstrated experience creating maintainable Infrastructure as Code, reusable modules, environment configuration, state management, policy controls, and automated provisioning at scale.
* Scripting and automation: Strong Shell scripting and Python experience for operational tooling, integrations, validations, remediation, and workflow automation; practical experience with Ansible for configuration management and application/platform automation.
* Web and application infrastructure: Hands-on understanding of IIS, JBoss, and Apache administration, configuration, troubleshooting, patching, reverse proxying, Java application hosting, SSL/TLS, certificates, load balancers, and integration with enterprise applications.
* Observability: Good hands-on experience with Datadog and/or equivalent observability platforms, covering monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboards, alerting, synthetic or endpoint checks, and incident correlation.
* ITSM and operations: Working knowledge of ITSM practices and operational controls, including incident, problem, change, service request, major-incident, SLA, knowledge-management, and root-cause-analysis processes.
* Systems and troubleshooting: Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server, networking fundamentals, firewalls, DNS, identity/access, relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL, and vendor-supported enterprise applications.
* Leadership: Ability to lead technical initiatives, manage competing priorities, communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders, and mentor junior engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cloud breadth: Working knowledge of AWS and Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud requirement for the role.
* Delivery practices: Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, release automation, DevOps practices, and secure software delivery.
* Platform experience: Experience supporting SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, vendor-built applications, cloud migrations, and hybrid enterprise environments.
* Certifications: GCP, Terraform, Ansible, ITIL, or other relevant cloud and infrastructure certifications are desirable.
* Continuous improvement: Ability to use AI capabilities where they deliver business value and improve support, operations, and user productivity.
* Leadership behaviors: Demonstrates ownership, initiative, integrity, constructive challenge, collaboration, and an engaging leadership style; develops people and drives initiatives from idea through execution.

**SUPPORT REQUIREMENT**

* The role requires extended off-hours coverage, including overnight, weekend, and holiday on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs and the team’s operational support model.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**About You**
You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors.
  
  
You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.
  
  
Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):
  
  

* Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
* Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
* Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
* Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
* Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
* Liaising with internal teams & management groups
* Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
* Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
* Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience.
  
  
People Management.
  
  
As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.
  
  
Incident Management.
  
  
You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management.
  
  
Vendor Management.
  
  
An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same.
  
  
Process Improvement.
  
  
You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable
  
  
Health & Safety.
  
  
Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience
* 7+ years of managing large complex facilities organizations experience
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* 4+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
* Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field, or 6+ months of network and operating system support experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in project/program management
* 1+ years of Agile methods and processes experience
* Experience in capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar
* Knowledge of Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma concepts
* Experience implementing change management successfully transitioning programs into large-scale operations

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Network Engineer
description:

At IMC, the Trading Infrastructure team is responsible for the WAN, LANs, and all low-latency connectivity to trading venues. You will work closely with Systems Engineers, internal teams, and external partners to deliver best-in-class solutions that support our trading business and help evolve our infrastructure to meet the demands of a dynamic industry.
  
  
**Your Core Responsibilities**

* Design, implement and support the networking infrastructure. Key areas include Low-latency networking, Unicast and Multicast routing, OSPF, BGP, PIM SM, as well as things like QoS, STP, NAT, protocol tuning, etc.
* Monitor, guard and analyze the proper functioning of our network infrastructure. Take adaptive, retentive and corrective measures and perform structural maintenance.
* Proactively improve our infrastructure by contributing scripts and code to our automation efforts (e.g. Bash, Python).
* Accurately create and maintain documentation detailing the implemented network components, as well as relevant procedures and other documentation.
* Responsibility for our IT security related platforms. Key areas include Palo Alto firewalls, VPNs, Security policies, etc.
* Work flexible hours. We are proud of the uptime of the trading environment, so every now and then you will be working outside of regular business hours to apply critical changes. This could be from your desk, your couch at home or also inside of one of our datacenters abroad.
* Liaise with external vendors, exchanges and providers to explore new technology solutions, implement new services or troubleshoot problems.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* 5+ years of experience as a Network Engineer, with a passion for all aspects of networking
* Proven ability to design, implement, and support high-performance networks
* Strong appetite for accuracy and willingness to go beyond standard textbook networking concepts
* Collaborative mindset with experience working closely across cross-functional teams
* Ability to motivate and encourage peers while maintaining a high technical standard

title: IT & Security Operations Lead
description:
**Who We Are**

ParamAIQ is an applied-AI company building NyaayOS, the reasoning layer for Indian law. We turn the primary sources of Indian law, from the BNS, BNSS and BSA to decades of Supreme Court and High Court precedent, into something any advocate can stand on. Work that took days takes minutes.

India has more than 55 million pending cases, and the outcome for a litigant can turn on who they can afford. We're building the foundation that gives an independent lawyer the same analytical leverage as a partner at a leading firm, and we build it with practising lawyers, not just for them.

**Why This Role Matters**

Today we run on Microsoft 365 and Slack with no central identity platform, no device management baseline, no formal service desk, and no security framework. There is no Active Directory. This is not a role that inherits a mature estate and governs it.

This is a build role first and a governance role second. In your first year you'll design and stand up the identity, endpoint, network and security foundations for the whole group, and then run them well. You'll have one engineer working to you from day one, real budget, and a direct line to the CTO. You'll also be hands-on: at our size, the person who designs conditional access is the same person who occasionally re-images a laptop.

**What You'll Own**

* Identity & access: Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory as the group's authoritative identity source. SSO, MFA, conditional access, RBAC, privileged access, joiner-mover-leaver, and periodic access reviews.
* Microsoft 365: Tenant administration and governance, Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, licensing optimisation, multi-entity and multi-domain design, and security baselines.
* Slack: End-to-end administration (Teams chat is deliberately disabled). SSO and SCIM from Entra ID, retention and eDiscovery, DLP, app approval, and guest governance.
* Endpoint management: A mixed Windows and macOS fleet of roughly 100 devices. Intune, Apple Business Manager with zero-touch enrolment, FileVault escrow, and a macOS patching approach of your recommendation.
* Security operations: SPF, DKIM and DMARC across all domains, endpoint protection, vulnerability posture, phishing simulation and awareness training, shadow-IT discovery, secrets hygiene, and an incident response runbook you've actually rehearsed.
* Compliance & audit: IT controls evidence for SOC 2, IT's obligations under India's DPDP Act including breach notification readiness, the asset register, e-waste rules, and access control and CCTV administration.
* Infrastructure & network: Firewall, VPN, Wi-Fi and ISPs, the new Mumbai office comms room and cabling handover, and the physical environment for on-premises GPU infrastructure (power, cooling, access, encryption at rest).
* Backup, DR & continuity: Backup standards, defined recovery objectives, restores tested on a schedule, and documented continuity procedures.
* Service management: Select and run our first ticketing system, publish SLAs, direct the Network & Helpdesk Engineer's work, and own major incident escalation.
* Vendors & budget: Microsoft partners, ISPs, hardware and SaaS vendors. Contracts, renewals, endpoint procurement, vendor security reviews, and input into the annual IT budget.

**What Success Looks Like in Year One**

We'll judge this role on outcomes, not activity. By the end of your first twelve months we expect:

* Identity is authoritative: Entra ID and Active Directory deployed, everyone provisioned from a single source, and SSO live for our top applications including Slack
* MFA and conditional access at 100%: No exceptions without a documented, time-bound approval
* Every device managed: 100% of Windows and macOS endpoints enrolled, encrypted, patch-compliant and in a single inventory
* Joiner-mover-leaver is a process, not a favour: Documented, measured against an SLA, with offboarding that reliably revokes access on the day it should
* A service desk exists: Ticketing live, SLAs published, and a baseline satisfaction measure
* Recovery is proven, not assumed: At least one full documented restore test for each critical system
* Audit-ready: SOC 2 IT evidence produced on a defined schedule, and DPDP obligations mapped to owners
* The estate is documented: Asset register, network documentation, and runbooks your engineer can work from without you

**Scope Boundary**

* You own corporate IT: identity, endpoints, the corporate network, SaaS, and the physical technology environment, including power, cooling, access control and encryption for our on-premises GPU hardware.
* Engineering owns production cloud infrastructure, the build and deployment pipeline, and the product environment. You're consulted on those and own identity and access into them, but you're not the approver for production change.
* Where the boundary is genuinely unclear, raise it rather than either annexing or ignoring it.

**What You Bring**

* You've personally built a Microsoft identity platform from nothing, with Entra ID and Active Directory designed, deployed and cut over, not just administered one someone else built
* Deep, hands-on Microsoft 365 tenant administration: Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, licensing, security baselines and conditional access
* Real endpoint management across Windows and macOS, including Intune and Apple Business Manager, and opinions about managing Macs properly
* You've carried SOC 2, ISO 27001 or an equivalent framework as the person who produced the IT evidence, not a bystander to the audit
* Comfortable being hands-on and hands-off in the same day: architecture in the morning, a stuck user in the afternoon, without resenting either
* You can lead one engineer well: allocate work, review it honestly, and grow them
* Patience with non-technical users in a trading business and a biotech who don't think in tickets

**Bonus Points**

* Slack administration at organisation scale: SCIM, retention, DLP, eDiscovery, app governance
* Multi-entity or multi-company tenant design, including data segregation and per-entity licensing and cost allocation
* Familiarity with India's DPDP Act as it applies to IT operations
* Commissioning a new office: comms room, structured cabling, access control and CCTV integration
* Exposure to on-premises GPU or high-density compute environments
* Working fluency in Hindi or Marathi alongside English

**What You Get**

* A true build opportunity: design the group's identity, endpoint, network and security foundations from scratch
* One engineer working to you from day one, and real budget
* A direct line to the CTO
* Group-wide scope across trading, biotech and legal tech, including the infrastructure behind India's agentic legal AI

title: Rack Lifecycle Team Manager , Rack Lifecycle Team
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on, operationally focused Rack Lifecycle Team Manager to join our Infrastructure Operations team, owning the day-to-day execution of rack lifecycle operations within data center sites. This role is responsible for the full continuum of rack operations — from demand intake and rack landing, through Late Binding cabling, rack installation and handoff, to end-of-life decommissioning — at the site level.
  
  
You will lead a team of data center technicians, translating organizational capacity goals into executed deliverables on the floor. As a tactical leader, you are the single accountable owner for ensuring every rack needed for customer capacity lands on time, is cabled and installed to standard, has no install blockers at handoff, and is decommissioned safely and compliantly at end-of-life.
  
  
Your work directly supports AWS's ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably and at the lowest possible cost, while maintaining the highest standards of safety, security, and environmental compliance.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Rack Delivery & Installation
  
  

* Lead planning and execution of network deployments including rack installs, structured cabling, fiber trunks, and MMR/CFA builds to meet committed customer capacity dates
* Coordinate site readiness, RSPC readiness (Rack Space Power Cooling); ensure racks are landed, cabled, and ready for cabling patching and install per standards
* Proactively identify and drive resolution of blockers across permits, site access, facilities, power, cross-connects, and vendor dependencies
* Drive cross-team coordination with DCO, DCEO, LOG, security, CDP, Supply chain, Transport and GND during deployment waves, running escalation touchpoints and daily stand-ups as needed
* Ensuring rack installations are as per MOP/SOP and documenting the handovers for later refences and improvements

Cabling Infrastructure (Late Binding)
  
  

* Own scope for fiber/copper cabling, patching schedules, and labeling standards for the site
* Validate OTDR/power testing and as-built documentation; ensure cabling meets quality standards and capacity requirements before handoff
* Maintain cabling infrastructure governance including CMDB accuracy and port map integrity post-installation
* Identify systemic cabling quality gaps and implement corrective actions to improve cycle times and first-pass quality

Supply Chain & Logistics
  
  

* Track rack, cable, optics, and network BOM from PO to site; monitor lead times, logistics, customs clearance, and site inventory levels
* Flag supply chain risks to schedule early and coordinate with procurement, logistics, and vendor partners on mitigation plans
* Ensure material availability aligns with deployment timelines; maintain site-level inventory accuracy

Stakeholder Management & Blocker Removal
  
  

* Serve as the single point of contact for internal customers, DC Ops, facilities, transport, and vendors for site-level rack lifecycle activities
* Run daily and weekly war rooms during deployment waves; provide timely status updates and escalate blockers to senior leadership as needed
* Build effective working relationships with cross-functional partners to ensure alignment and uninterrupted delivery execution

Rack Decommissioning (Decom)
  
  

* Own the site-level decommission pipeline for EOL racks; coordinate with Capacity Planning, Network Operations, and DCLM/ALM teams to schedule graceful shutdowns with zero service impact
* Lead physical decommission activities — device wipe, media destruction, cable removal, power disconnect, asset de-tagging, and rack removal — ensuring full MOP and EHS compliance
* Track and recover reusable assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware); coordinate RMA, liquidation, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics and Environmental policies
* Validate that reclaimed power, cooling, and U-space is accurately returned to the available pool; drive re-use to defer new builds and improve TCO
* Ensure data hygiene post-decom including DCIM/CMDB updates, IPAM releases, port map reconciliation, and circuit/cross-connect documentation

Governance, Metrics & Reporting
  
  

* Track and report on site-level KPIs including: racks landed vs. plan, Late Binding cabling completion %, capacity ready dates, received vs. installed cycle time, decom backlog vs. flightpath goal, and shipment achievement %
* Define and enforce site-level policies, SOPs, and governance frameworks aligned with AWS standards and industry best practices across all rack lifecycle phases
* Provide accurate, data-driven reporting on delivery performance, blockers, and improvement initiatives to the Cluster Manager and senior leadership
* Champion adoption of tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) to reduce manual effort, improve data accuracy, and accelerate delivery cycle times

Handover & Documentation
  
  

* Ensure clean, documented handoffs to Data Center Operations teams with updated CMDB/DCIM records, port maps, test results, and completed workflow sign-offs — with zero blockers at handoff
* Maintain accurate and current records in DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and related systems throughout all lifecycle phases
* Ensure all as-built documentation, cabling records, and workflow completions are captured and auditable

Team Leadership & Operations Management
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of data center technicians; manage staffing, scheduling, and day-to-day workforce planning for the site
* Conduct regular team meetings, drive performance accountability, and ensure appropriate training and skill development across all lifecycle functions
* Translate organizational goals into actionable team objectives; manage sprint planning, team output quality, and SLA compliance
* Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and performance management; make staffing recommendations in partnership with manager and HR
* Foster a high-performance, inclusive, and safety-first team culture

A day in the life
  
  
As the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager for your site, no two days are the same. You might start your morning reviewing the site's daily rack landing dashboard, checking in with your technicians on an active cabling wave, and triaging a supply chain delay flagged overnight. By midday, you could be on the data center floor coordinating a rack placement with facilities, validating a power sign-off checklist before a network device install, or running a decom stand-up to confirm MOP readiness for an EOL rack removal. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records following a completed handoff, reviewing your team's KPI performance ahead of a weekly operations review, or coaching a technician on structured cabling standards. Your role is tactical and hands-on — you execute with your team, remove blockers in real time, and hold the line on quality and schedule at the site level.
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree, or 4+ years of education or related field experience
* 3+ years of direct people management, including managing managers or senior individual contributors experience
* 2+ years of relevant discipline work, or 5+ years of data center engineering or operations experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2+ years of data center, critical environment, computer hardware repair, infrastructure cabling, network deployment, or data center operations experience, or experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)
* 2+ years of network cabling, fiber optics, and test equipment including VFL, power meter, and OTDR experience, or experience related IT
* Experience measuring key operational metrics (e.g., order cycle time, ship estimate accuracy, on-time and complete shipment, inventory record defect rate)
* industry standard certification (CompTIA, CCENT, or Network+), or experience working in a colocation data center facility
* Experience managing and negotiating contracts and vendor relationships

As Manager – IT Operations, you will be responsible for the administration, security, governance, and operational excellence of the organization's enterprise IT ecosystem, including Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Active Directory, Enterprise applications, Network infrastructure, Backup platforms, and Compliance controls. The role requires an L2/L3-level technology professional capable of managing business-critical systems while ensuring availability, security, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Identity & Access Management**

* Administer Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, Exchange Online, and Intune.
* Manage user and asset lifecycle, access governance, privileged access management (PAM), MFA, Conditional Access, and Zero Trust controls.
* Conduct periodic access reviews, entitlement audits, and privilege validation exercises.

**Enterprise Applications**

* Administer and support CRM, HRMS, Attendance, Service Desk, and other business applications.
* Manage configurations, workflows, integrations, user permissions, upgrades, and application security.
* Ensure application availability, performance, and continuous improvement.

**Information Security & Compliance**

* Implement and manage Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls and support DPDPA compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with Information Security teams on governance, risk mitigation, vulnerability remediation, audit readiness, VAPT closure, and incident response activities.
* Monitor compliance with organizational security standards and policies.

**Network, Infrastructure & Business Continuity**

* Oversee enterprise network operations including firewalls, routers, switches, VPNs, SD-WAN, wireless infrastructure, and internet connectivity.
* Manage backup, recovery, disaster recovery testing, business continuity planning, operational runbooks SOP, and recovery documentation.
* Support infrastructure modernization, cloud adoption, and operational resilience initiatives.

**Governance & Vendor Management**

* Maintain operational dashboards, MIS, compliance reports, service metrics, and management reviews.
* Ensure adherence to Incident, Change, Problem, and Access Management processes.
* Drive automation, process optimization, and operational governance initiatives.
* Manage relationships with OEMs, vendors, service providers, and implementation partners while supporting technology upgrades, renewals, and escalations.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline.
* 5–8 years of experience in IT Operations, Enterprise Systems Administration, Infrastructure Management, Application Administration, or Information Security Operations.
* Experience managing enterprise platforms in compliance-driven or regulated environments is preferred.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**
Microsoft 365
  
  

* Microsoft Entra ID
* Intune
* Active Directory
* Exchange Online
* IAM
* Conditional Access
* MFA
* PAM
* DLP
* DPDPA Controls
* Enterprise Application Administration
* Windows Server Administration
* Network Administration (Firewalls, Routers, Switches, VPNs, Wireless)
* Backup & Recovery
* IT Governance & Operational Controls
* Reporting & MIS.

**Preferred Skills & Certifications**
**Skills:**
Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, SIEM Platforms, PowerShell Automation, API Integrations, AWS/Azure, ITIL Framework, ISO 27001, CRM Administration.
  
  
**Certifications:**
Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, Identity & Access Administrator, Security Administrator, Intune Administrator, ITIL Foundation/ITIL 4.
  
  
**Core Competencies**
Strong ownership, analytical and problem-solving skills, enterprise operations expertise, stakeholder and vendor management, documentation and reporting excellence, independent decision-making ability, accountability, integrity, and attention to detail.
  
  
**Working Conditions**
Participation in maintenance windows, audits, security incidents, disaster recovery exercises, and occasional travel to branch offices, datacentres, or vendor locations may be required.

description:

**AI - IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Security – Senior**
**Role Summary**
We are looking for an AI - IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Security Senior professional with solution mindset and hands on security engineering expertise in network security / Infrastructure security concepts, risk and controls concepts, architecture design, transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a Senior professional who should have practical experience in network security engineering, detection engineering, and OT cyber risk reduction, with growing exposure to AI-assisted security operations, prompt engineering, AI-driven anomaly detection, and device behavior analytics.
  
  
This role is part of the Cyber Frontier & AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Understands design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Possess knowledge about deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE,DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Incident response and security improvement initiatives to enhance cyber resilience across hybrid infrastructure.
* Possess knowledge & experience on secure remote access, DMZ architecture, PLC security, and cloud network protection.
* Good understanding on AI-assisted IT/OT security architecture and operations, enabling predictive threat monitoring and automated response within industrial environments.
* Understands AI-driven anomaly detection models to identify deviations in OT network traffic, process behaviors, and industrial protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, OPC).
* Build AI-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.
* Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.
* Implement AI-powered device behavior profiling, establishing baselines for PLCs, HMIs, and IoT/IIoT assets to detect unauthorized or abnormal activities.
* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
* Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network & Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4–8 years of experience across AI driven Network & Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.
* Experience with OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
* Expertise in XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Strong capability in multi-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
* Strong client-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good soft skills i.e. verbal & written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Knowledge of Information security standards and compliances (ISO 27001, ISO 27017, NIST 800 53, NIST 800-207, CISA, CIS benchmark etc.)
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco & others)

**Why join us**
Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network & infra structure security portfolio in an AI-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network & infrastructure security practice as technology-enabled, consulting-led, and globally delivered.

The company has invested in multiple solar projects under the OPEX (CAPEX-free / RESCO) business model, where continuous monitoring of generation, plant performance, equipment health, and operational efficiency is essential.

As part of its technology development strategy, Roofsol Energy intends to establish its own end-to-end solar monitoring ecosystem, including proprietary data loggers, IoT-based data acquisition systems, cloud infrastructure, and a centralized solar generation monitoring platform. The objective is to develop and own the underlying technology and Intellectual Property (IP), while ensuring reliable monitoring and management of a large portfolio of distributed solar projects across India.

**Role Overview**

Roofsol Energy is looking for an experienced technology professional to lead the conceptualization, design, development, deployment, and maintenance of an in-house solar data logging and generation monitoring system.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy and Technology Development**

·      Define the technology roadmap for Roofsol Energy’s proprietary solar monitoring and data acquisition ecosystem.

·      Lead the end-to-end development of the monitoring platform, from product architecture and prototype development to commercial deployment.

·      Evaluate appropriate hardware, communication protocols, software frameworks, cloud technologies, and system architectures.

·      Develop solutions suitable for both small rooftop solar installations and large distributed solar portfolios.

**2. Data Logger and IoT Hardware Development**

·      Lead the design, development, prototyping, testing, and deployment of in-house solar data logging equipment.

·      Develop expertise in integrating inverters, energy meters, weather sensors, and other plant equipment using protocols such as Modbus RTU/TCP, RS485, Ethernet, and MQTT, as applicable.

·      Ensure reliable data acquisition, local buffering, time synchronization, remote configuration, and recovery during network or power outages.

·      Establish hardware validation, field testing, quality assurance, and lifecycle management processes.

**3. Cloud Platform and Software Development**

·      Lead the architecture and development of a centralized cloud-based solar monitoring platform.

·      Establish scalable infrastructure for collecting, processing, storing, and analyzing data from hundreds of geographically distributed solar installations.

·      Oversee the development of dashboards, plant-level monitoring screens, portfolio-level reporting, alerts, notifications, and automated performance reports.

·      Ensure integration with existing business systems, maintenance workflows, and third-party equipment where required.

·      Establish high availability, disaster recovery, backup, cybersecurity, and system performance standards.

**4. Solar Generation Monitoring and Analytics**

·      Develop real-time and historical solar generation monitoring capabilities.

·      Establish monitoring of energy generation, plant availability, equipment health, communication failures, and performance deviations.

·      Enable automated alerts for generation losses, inverter faults, abnormal operating conditions, and data gaps.

·      Support performance analysis through relevant metrics such as specific yield, Performance Ratio (PR), plant availability, and actual-versus-expected generation, where applicable.

**5. Intellectual Property and Technology Ownership**

·      Build and maintain Roofsol Energy’s proprietary technology stack, including hardware designs, firmware, software source code, system architecture, technical documentation, and associated IP.

·      Establish appropriate IP ownership, confidentiality, source-code control, licensing, and third-party technology compliance practices.

**6. Team Leadership and Vendor Management**

·      Build and lead a multidisciplinary team covering embedded systems, electronics, firmware, IoT, cloud engineering, software development, and data analytics.

·      Evaluate and manage technology vendors, hardware manufacturers, system integrators, and development partners.

**Candidate Profile**

·      Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics & Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, IoT, or a related technical discipline.

·      Approximately 10 years of relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, industrial data acquisition, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, or related technology domains.

·      Demonstrated experience in developing and deploying connected hardware and software products, preferably from concept through production and field deployment.

·      Experience with cloud infrastructure, databases, APIs, cybersecurity, remote device management, and scalable system architecture.

·      Knowledge of solar PV systems, inverter communications, energy meters, generation monitoring, and renewable energy analytics will be highly advantageous.

**Why Join Roofsol Energy?**

This is an opportunity to establish a proprietary technology platform from the ground up and take ownership of a strategic digital initiative within the renewable energy sector. The selected professional will have the opportunity to shape the company’s technology roadmap, develop in-house IP, and build a scalable monitoring ecosystem supporting a growing portfolio of solar assets across India.

**Interested candidates may share their updated CV highlighting relevant experience in IoT product development, embedded systems, cloud platforms, energy monitoring, and technology ownership.**

description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Networking Service Delivery Field Support Engineer (L1) is responsible for providing a professional first-line onsite technical support and field engineering service to clients by proactively identifying and resolving technical incidents and problems. Through pre-emptive service incident and resolution activities, this role restores service to clients by managing incidents and seeing them through to an effective resolution. The primary objective of this role is to ensure all requests, process events and resolution incidents result in zero missed Service Level Agreement (SLA) conditions. The role is responsible for managing standard and low complexity incidents, conducting routine, repetitive tasks whilst using readily available information and following standard practices and procedures.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Ensures that the assigned infrastructure at the client site is configured, installed, tested and operational.
* Ensures that any software that is part of the solution is installed and configured according to client requirements.
* Proactively identifies problems and errors as they occur and logs such incidents in a timely manner with the required level of detail.

* Investigates first line support calls assigned and identify the root cause of incidents and problems following knowledge articles.
* Responds to and diagnoses all alerts, escalate to L2 Field Engineer when unable to resolve within the stipulated time.
* Ensures incidents are updated with progress and resolution details in a timely manner using the required platform.

* Applies tools, techniques and processes to track, log, report on and correct configuration items, components and changes.
* Investigates problems in systems, processes and services and assists with the implementation of agreed remedies and preventative measures.
* Provides first line remote and onsite technical support to clients.
* Provides first line field engineering services to clients.
* Reports and escalates issues to 3rd party vendors if necessary.
* Follows the required handover procedures for shift changes to ensure service continuity.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Good communicate skills, both verbal and written.
* Ability to plan activities and projects well in advance, and take into account possible changing circumstances.
* Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work.
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment.
* Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary.
* Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information and refraining from interrupting.
* Ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
* Ability to place client at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements and creating a positive client experience throughout the total client journey.

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology or Computing or related field.
* Associate level certification in different Networking technologies such as Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, F5, CCNA, JNCIA, ACMA etc.

**Required experience:**

* Entry level experience in Networking technologies such as routing, switching, Wireless, SDI distribution, core and access layers.
* Entry level experience in technical support to clients.
* Entry level experience in diagnosis and troubleshooting.
* Entry level experience providing remote support in Networking technologies.

title: Data Center Technician
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Experience with Linux Administration.
* Experience with network infrastructure.
* Experience in hardware and operating systems.
* Experience in technical support operations, network diagnostics, and project management.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems, computer hardware and server hardware.
* Experience with networking protocols, Linux, teamwork and operations.
* Ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, holidays and on shift-based schedules.

**About The Job**
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also address the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.
  
  
You install, configure, test and troubleshoot hardware (servers and components) and server software. You also manually move and install racks and servers.
  
  
The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or teams (e.g. Machine Learning platforms, network architecture).
* Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose moderately complex issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and identify the resources needed to resolve identified issues.
* Diagnose, repair, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, and infrastructure based on identified issues with multiple solutions, independently.
* Independently execute advanced operational procedures as part of daily work activities and follow security policies and processes.
* Work in shifts may be required to meet evolving business needs and operational schedules.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Data Center Engineer
description:
**About Millennium**
Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.
  
  
Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.
  
  
**Meet the Team**
Core to the health and growth of our business, Millennium’s Information Technology organization supports a flexible, scalable technology environment and advanced proprietary systems across the firm. Within that organization, the global Network & Datacentre team manages critical datacentre and office technology infrastructure that underpins regional growth, operational resilience, and connectivity across Millennium’s platform.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the day-to-day physical operation of Millennium’s India datacentre facility and associated office technology rooms, including power, cooling, space, cabling, and security.
* Perform hands-on datacentre work including racking and stacking, structured copper and fibre cabling, labelling, patching, and maintaining strong cable hygiene standards.
* Manage hardware lifecycle activities across servers, storage, and network equipment, including installations, upgrades, moves, adds, changes, and decommissioning.
* Coordinate and execute hardware replacements and RMAs with local and international vendors, while helping maintain service continuity.
* Monitor infrastructure and environmental alerts, respond to incidents, perform first-line troubleshooting, and support a 24x7 operating environment through maintenance windows and extended-hours work as needed.
* Work within established ITIL and ITSM processes for incidents, requests, and changes, while maintaining accurate asset, location, and connectivity records in platforms including ServiceNow and Nlyte.
* Support network device deployment and basic configuration under the direction of Network Engineering, including physical connectivity, VLAN validation, link checks, and basic Layer 2 and Layer 3 troubleshooting.
* Contribute to tooling, automation, and integration efforts across DCIM, monitoring, logging, CMDB, and capacity platforms, while improving runbooks, SOPs, and recurring operational processes.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in a datacentre or large-scale infrastructure environment, ideally within financial services or another mission-critical setting.
* Proven hands-on experience managing racks, cabling, hardware installations, and decommissioning across multi-cabinet environments.
* Experience supporting office technology rooms or comms rooms, including IDF and MDF environments, in addition to core datacentres.
* Strong working knowledge of datacentre power and cooling concepts, including PDUs, UPS, dual feeds, capacity management, and hot aisle or cold aisle design.
* Solid CCNA-level networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, VLANs, trunking, subnetting, basic routing, and access control concepts, with the ability to perform CLI-based troubleshooting on enterprise network devices.
* Experience working with remote management and operational tooling, including technologies such as IPMI, iDRAC, iLO, console servers, ServiceNow, Jira, and DCIM or CMDB platforms.
* Basic scripting capability in Python, PowerShell, or Bash to support task automation, reporting, and data handling.
* Strong documentation, communication, and coordination skills, with a high level of ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with local facilities teams, vendors, and global stakeholders across time zones.
