title: Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 7+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Be mobile and travel to client locations as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Vendor Personnel
description:
**Job Description**
**Shift – 24\*7 (Rotational)**
**Critical Infrastructure Engineer – Reliability & Infrastructure Analytics – For backlog and proactive gap fixing (L2/L3)**
**Role Purpose**
The Critical Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for monitoring, managing and improving the reliability of critical infrastructure supporting telecom and data centre operations. The role focuses on ensuring high availability of power, cooling and environmental systems while proactively identifying infrastructure risks, recurring alarms and opportunities for permanent corrective action. The engineer is expected to move beyond reactive incident handling by driving backlog reduction, equipment refresh planning and long-term infrastructure reliability improvements. This aligns with the current CI direction of moving from repeat break-fix to asset-led preventive management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage a team of Critical Infrastructure Engineers/Technicians, ensuring effective shift coverage, operational governance, coaching, workload balancing and adherence to operational standards.
* Analyze infrastructure trends and proactively identify recurring alarms, noisy sites, aging infrastructure and operational gaps impacting service reliability.
* Drive Top Talker analysis, identify recurring failure patterns and develop permanent corrective action plans to eliminate repeat alarms and unnecessary dispatches.
* Review historical incidents, alarm trends and backlog tickets to identify systemic issues and recommend engineering improvements.
* Prepare and present analytical reports, dashboards and executive summaries highlighting recurring issues, infrastructure risks, equipment performance and operational improvements.
* Identify End-of-Life (EOL) / End-of-Support (EOS) equipment, evaluate operational risk and prepare structured equipment refresh and replacement plans for management review.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Vendors and Field teams to drive permanent remediation, equipment replacement and closure of long-pending infrastructure issues.
* Maintain ownership of backlog reduction initiatives and ensure ageing tickets are continuously reviewed, tracked and driven to closure.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities for automation, operational efficiencies and proactive monitoring enhancements. This aligns with the CI objective of moving from repeat break-fix to asset-led preventive management.

**Additional Required Skills**

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret operational data, identify trends and convert findings into actionable recommendations.
* Ability to identify recurring alarms, noisy sites and infrastructure risks using data analysis and operational reporting.
* Strong leadership and people-management skills with experience managing technical teams, conducting coaching sessions and driving operational governance.
* Excellent documentation skills with the ability to create and maintain detailed operational records, RCA reports, equipment history, maintenance documentation and knowledge articles that can be used for future troubleshooting, audits and continuous improvement.
* Ability to prepare executive-level reports and present infrastructure risks, backlog analysis, EOL/EOS recommendations and permanent-fix roadmaps to management.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills with the ability to coordinate effectively across Operations, Engineering, Vendors, OEMs and Field teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Must have prior experience leading technical teams in a Telecom, Data Center or Critical Infrastructure environment.
* Experience preparing SOPs, MOPs, RCA documentation, equipment history records, maintenance logs and audit documentation.
* Experience working with BMS/DCIM/EMS platforms and infrastructure monitoring tools.
* Exposure to asset lifecycle management, equipment refresh programs and preventive maintenance planning.
* Experience analyzing recurring infrastructure incidents and implementing permanent corrective actions.

**Key Deliverables**

* Reduction in recurring alarms and noisy sites through permanent corrective actions.
* Proactive identification and reporting of infrastructure risks, ageing assets and EOL/EOS equipment.
* Improved infrastructure reliability through analytical trend monitoring and preventive maintenance.
* Reduction in backlog and ageing infrastructure tickets.
* Comprehensive documentation and knowledge repositories that improve future troubleshooting, onboarding and operational continuity.
* Strong team performance, governance and continuous coaching to improve operational maturity.

description:

VMware NSX-T Data Center

NA

15 years full time education
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
HCX Core Support
  
  
Deploy and configure VMware HCX Connector, HCX Manager, and Service Mesh appliances across source and destination sites
  
  
Support bi-directional VM migrations using vMotion, Bulk Migration, Cold Migration, and Replication Assisted vMotion (RAV)
  
  
Manage HCX site pairing, fleet upgrades, and appliance lifecycle operations
  
  
Troubleshoot HCX interconnect, WAN optimization, and tunnel failures
  
  
MON — Mobility Optimized Networking
  
  
Configure and manage HCX Network Extension with MON to enable migrated VMs to reach segments within the SDDC without sending packets back to the source environment router Broadcom
  
  
Set Target Router Location (Cloud/On-premises) at per-VM granularity for vMotion- and RAV-migrated workloads
  
  
Configure and validate MON policy routes that define which traffic is routed through the source gateway versus traffic routed through the cloud gateway Broadcom
  
  
Diagnose and resolve network tromboning issues on Layer-2 extended segments
  
  
Enable/disable MON at the time of stretching a network or on already extended networks, and on an individual VM basis for VMs residing on extended networks in the SDDC Broadcom
  
  
NSX & Network Integration
  
  
Ensure NSX Tier-1 router is connected to a Tier-0 router in the cloud environment prior to enabling MON, and that Layer-2 network extensions terminate correctly on Tier-1
  
  
Validate NSX requirements for extended segments and troubleshoot Gateway/DHCP IP conflicts
  
  
Work with NSX-T constructs (T0/T1, segments, distributed routing) in destination SDDC environments
  
  
Cloud Platform Support
  
  
Support HCX deployments on VMware Cloud on AWS, Azure VMware Solution, or Google Cloud VMware Engine
  
  
Ensure HCX Enterprise license activation for MON features
  
  
Coordinate with cloud platform teams for SDDC Compute Gateway configuration related to MON
  
  
**Required Skills & Experience**
6 - 7 years of experience in VMware virtualization and data center infrastructure
  
  
Hands-on experience with VMware HCX deployment and operations (HCX 4.x preferred)
  
  
Solid understanding of Mobility Optimized Networking (MON) and how it prevents network tromboning on extended L2 segments
  
  
Strong NSX-T knowledge: T0/T1 routers, segments, distributed firewall
  
  
Familiarity with VMware vSphere (ESXi, vCenter, vMotion, DRS)
  
  
Understanding of L2 network extension, VLAN stretching, and hybrid cloud networking
  
  
Experience with VMware Cloud on AWS or Azure VMware Solution is a plus
  
  
Knowledge of HCX Enterprise licensing requirements for MON activation
  
  
Proficiency in network troubleshooting (packet capture, routing tables, MTU/path analysis)
  
  
**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**
VMware certifications: VCP-NV, VCP-DCV, VCAP, or HCX Specialist
  
  
Exposure to Broadcom/VMware support portal and KB-based troubleshooting
  
  
Scripting skills for automation (PowerCLI, Python, REST API for HCX)
  
  
Experience with FHRP (HSRP/VRRP) interactions with MON (a known compatibility consideration in HCX 4.7+)
  
  
Familiarity with HCX HA (High Availability) for Network Extension appliances
  
  
Key Competencies
  
  
Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset for complex hybrid cloud network issues
  
  
Ability to collaborate across infrastructure, cloud, and network teams
  
  
Customer-facing support experience (L2/L3 escalation handling)
  
  
Clear documentation skills for runbooks and migration plan.

**The Opportunity**
In this role, you will be responsible for leading an enterprise IT team of and ensure high availability, scalability, and robust security across complex LAN, WAN, Data Center, Wireless, SD-WAN, and Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) environments. The Director will drive network modernization, support digital transformation initiatives, oversee multi-OEM environments, and align technical strategy with core business objectives, offshore delivery centers (ODCs), and enterprise customer requirements.

* Formulate and implement the long-term strategic roadmap for global network operations, aligning network architecture with business goals.
* Drive infrastructure transformation initiatives, modernizing legacy systems to support hybrid cloud, SD-WAN, and automated NaaS frameworks.
* Serve as a key advisor to senior leadership, providing regular updates on network performance, risks, capital projects, and operational metrics.
* Oversee the end-to-end design, deployment, optimization, and maintenance of enterprise network infrastructure (Routing & Switching, LAN/WAN, Data Centers, Wireless, Load Balancing, and VPNs).
* Establish and monitor stringent Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to guarantee network reliability, performance, and proactive issue mitigation.
* Enforce robust Incident, Problem, and Change Management frameworks to ensure rapid SLA resolution and minimal business disruption.
* Direct and support ongoing, large-scale network deployment and upgrade projects.
* Lead, mentor, and scale an enterprise network operations organization of ~50 engineers and managers across internal IT and GCC (Global Capability Center) / ODC environments.
* Cultivate a high-performance, collaborative engineering culture through clear goal-setting, continuous training, performance reviews, and succession planning.
* Develop and manage the global network operational (OpEx) and capital (CapEx) budgets, driving resource efficiency and strategic cost optimization.
* Oversee vendor relationships, contract negotiations, and SLA performance across multiple network OEMs, equipment providers, and telecom carriers.
* Manage enterprise customer expectations and customer-facing networks, particularly within Service-Based, ODC, or multi-tenant customer environments.
* Partner closely with Information Security leadership to define and enforce network security policies, zero-trust protocols, firewalls, and threat mitigation technologies.
* Ensure all network architecture and operational practices strictly adhere to regulatory requirements, data protection laws, and IT governance standards.

**The Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 15+ years of hands-on experience in managing enterprise-level network operations, engineering design, implementation, and troubleshooting.
* Proven track record in executive-level people management, leading teams of 30–50+ network engineers and IT managers.
* Demonstrated expertise in managing multi-OEM vendor environments and service-based/GCC/ODC network ecosystems.
* Deep knowledge of modern networking concepts including LAN/WAN architecture, BGP/OSPF routing, switching, perimeter firewalls, load balancers, SD-WAN, Wireless enterprise, Network-as-a-Service (NaaS), and network monitoring/telemetry tools.
* Strong command of business IT processes, ITIL frameworks, vendor SLA oversight, and CapEx/OpEx budgeting.
* CCIE (Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert), CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), CISM, or ITIL Foundation/Intermediate.
* Experience within Global Capability Centers (GCCs), Large IT Service-Based Organizations, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), or Enterprise Internal IT operating complex offshore delivery network architectures.

**Pre-Employment Screenings**
By TP policy, employment in this position will be contingent on your successful completion of and passage of a comprehensive background check, including global sanctions and watchlist screening.

title: Citrix Engineer L2/L3
description:
Hello All,

We have an opening for a
**Citrix Engineer**
at
**Turbhe, Navi Mumbai**
.

Job Description – Citrix Engineer

**Implementation, Migration & Operations**

**Experience:**
4–8 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Function:**
Infrastructure / End User Computing / Managed Services

**Position Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Citrix Engineer responsible for the implementation, administration, optimization, troubleshooting, and day-to-day operations of Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops environments.

The candidate will work across implementation projects, migrations, upgrades, L2/L3 operations, incident management, performance optimization, and customer support. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in Citrix technologies along with a good understanding of Microsoft Windows, Active Directory, networking, virtualization, and security.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Citrix Implementation & Deployment:**
Design, install, configure, and implement Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) / DAAS environments; configure Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, Studio, Director, Licensing, and VDAs; deploy Citrix Gateway / NetScaler ADC; configure Machine Catalogs, Delivery Groups, applications, desktops, and policies; integrate with Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, GPO, and authentication services.

**Citrix Migration & Upgrade:**
Perform Citrix version upgrades, migrations, and environment modernization; execute migrations with minimal downtime; migrate workloads between farms, sites, hypervisors, or infrastructure platforms; support migration to Citrix Cloud; perform health checks and post-migration validation.

**Operations & Administration:**
Manage production Citrix environments; monitor availability, capacity, and performance; troubleshoot login, application launch, session, VDA, profile, printing, and connectivity issues; manage policies, applications, desktops, sessions, and access permissions; perform preventive maintenance and 24x7 rotational support where required.

**Citrix ADC / NetScaler:**
Configure and troubleshoot Gateway virtual servers, authentication, certificates, SSL/TLS, session policies, and load balancing; perform firmware upgrades and configuration backup/restore.

**User Profile & Endpoint Technologies:**
Troubleshoot FSLogix, Citrix Profile Management, folder redirection, Windows multi-session/single-session environments, thin clients, endpoint connectivity, printers, scanners, USB redirection, and Citrix Workspace App.

**Virtualization & Infrastructure:**
Support Citrix environments hosted on VMware vSphere/ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, or Nutanix AHV; understand VM sizing, CPU, memory, storage, networking, and capacity planning.

**Incident, Problem & Change Management:**
Handle L2/L3 incidents and service requests; perform RCA; participate in problem management; implement changes following ITIL processes; support major incidents and customer escalations.

**Monitoring, Performance & Optimization:**
Use Citrix Director and monitoring platforms to analyze logon duration, VDA health, resource utilization, and application performance; identify bottlenecks and implement optimization/capacity improvements.

**Automation & Operational Improvement:**
Use PowerShell for administration, reporting, troubleshooting, and automation; automate health checks, reporting, user/session management, and repetitive operational tasks.

**Documentation & Customer Management:**
Maintain SOPs, KB articles, troubleshooting guides, health reports, and service reports; participate in customer meetings; provide technical recommendations; coordinate with OEM/vendor support; support audits and compliance.

**Required Technical Skills**

Must Have: Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops / CVAD, Citrix Studio and Director, Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, VDAs, Citrix Policies, Machine Catalogs and Delivery Groups, Citrix Gateway / NetScaler ADC, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Windows Server, Windows multi-session, FSLogix / Citrix Profile Management, VMware vSphere / ESXi or equivalent, PowerShell, and ITIL-based incident/change/problem management.

Good to Have: Citrix Cloud, Accops, Azure / Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop, Nutanix AHV, Microsoft Hyper-V, Microsoft Entra ID, MFA / SAML / OAuth, load balancing, Citrix WEM, monitoring/observability tools, and automation.

**Experience Requirements**

4–8 years of overall IT infrastructure experience.

Minimum 3+ years of hands-on Citrix administration/engineering experience.

Experience in Citrix implementation, migration, upgrade, and operations.

Experience supporting enterprise production environments and customer escalations.

**Key Competencies**

Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

Good communication and customer-handling skills.

Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.

Strong documentation skills.

Ability to handle critical incidents under pressure.

Good understanding of ITIL processes.

Ability to lead technical implementation activities.

Willingness to participate in rotational / 24x7 support when required.

Incident resolution and MTTR.

Change success rate.

Citrix environment availability.

Implementation quality and project completion.

Recurring incident reduction.

**Preferred Certifications**

Citrix Certified Professional – Virtualization (CCP-V).

Citrix Certified Associate – Virtualization (CCA-V).

Interested candidates can send me your resume on poojazende@orientindia.net

Regards,

Pooja

description:
**Job Purpose**
The Frontline Infrastructure Support Engineer (L2) is responsible for providing advanced technical support, incident resolution, and operational management across enterprise IT infrastructure. The role involves diagnosing and resolving complex infrastructure issues, performing administration activities, implementing changes, supporting problem management, and mentoring L1 engineers while ensuring high service availability and SLA compliance.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Infrastructure Administration & Operations**

* Administer and maintain Windows, Linux, virtualization, Kubernetes, storage, backup and GPU infrastructure to ensure high availability and operational stability.
* Perform proactive health checks, capacity monitoring, performance tuning, and preventive maintenance activities.

**Advanced Incident Management**

* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve Level 2 infrastructure incidents within defined SLAs.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents and coordinate with L3 teams for permanent resolution.
* Review escalations from L1 teams and provide technical guidance during incident resolution.
* Participate in Major Incident Management and support service restoration activities.

**Windows Server & Active Directory Administration**

* Administer Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, File Services, and Windows services.
* Manage user accounts, organizational units, security groups, permissions, and authentication-related activities.
* Troubleshoot server performance, replication, authentication, and domain-related issues.

**Linux Administration**

* Perform Linux server administration, including user management, package management, service configuration, performance tuning, and security patching.
* Analyze system logs, troubleshoot kernel and OS issues, and optimize server performance.

**Virtualization Administration**

* Administer Cloud native/VMware/Hyper-V environments, including VM provisioning, snapshots, cloning, migration, and resource optimization.
* Monitor hypervisor performance and troubleshoot virtualization platform issues.

**Kubernetes Administration**

* Administer Kubernetes clusters, including node management, workload deployment, pod lifecycle management, namespace administration, and cluster health monitoring.
* Troubleshoot cluster failures, resource constraints, networking, and orchestration issues.

**Storage & Backup Administration**

* Administer enterprise storage systems, LUN provisioning, storage allocation, capacity management, and performance optimization.
* Manage enterprise backup solutions, perform backup validation, restore operations, and troubleshoot backup failures.

**GPU Infrastructure Administration**

* Administer GPU-based infrastructure supporting AI/ML workloads.
* Monitor GPU utilization, troubleshoot hardware/software issues, perform firmware validation, and coordinate hardware replacement activities.

**Hardware & Data Center Support**

* Diagnose server hardware failures involving CPU, memory, storage, RAID, power supplies, and network interfaces.
* Coordinate hardware replacements with vendors and perform post-maintenance validation.

**Change & Problem Management**

* Execute approved infrastructure changes following organizational change management processes.
* Participate in Problem Management by identifying recurring issues and implementing preventive actions.

**Documentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Mentor L1 engineers and contribute to operational excellence and automation initiatives.
* Support audit, compliance, and governance activities.

**Experience & Educational Requirement**
BE/B-Tech or equivalent with Computer Science or Electronics & Communication
  
  
**Relevant Experience**

* 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Windows/Linux Administration, Active Directory, VMware/Hyper-V, Kubernetes, Storage & Backup Administration, Network Operations, GPU Infrastructure Administration, Troubleshooting, Incident, Problem Management and Infrastructure Troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting mission – critical production environments with 24 x 7 operations
* 4–6 years of experience in Hardware Support, Change Management, Documentation, ITIL Processes, Vendor Coordination, Automation (PowerShell/Bash/Python), Operational Reporting, and Team Collaboration.
* Preferred Exposure: Experience working with cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform, cloud native virtualization platforms, VMware, Nutanix, Kubernetes/Openshift environments, cloud native storage, Enterprise storage like NetApp & HPE etc. Backup Solution like Commvault & Cloud native backup tools, enterprise monitoring tools such as Zabbix, Zoho etc. & ITSM Platform including Manage Engine & Service Now etc. and GPU infrastructure supporting AI/ML workload is preferred

•Automation & Scripting: Use Python, Ansible, or Terraform to automate repetitive network tasks and configurations.

•Capacity Planning: Monitor network trends and provide data-driven recommendations for hardware refreshes and bandwidth scaling.

•Flexible to work in 24/7 environment

\*Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Telcom or a related field

Interested candidates can send me your resume on poojazende@orientindia.net

Regards,

Pooja

title: Data Center Technician , Data Center Operations (DCO)
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design, implement, and maintain Linux-based server infrastructures with a focus on reliability and scalability.
  
  
Perform comprehensive system monitoring, diagnostics, and performance optimization
  
  
Configure and manage network hardware, including switches, routers, and complex cabling systems
  
  
Develop and maintain robust backup and disaster recovery strategies.
  
  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless technological integration.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:
  
  

* You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
* You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
* You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
* You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
* You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews

**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and repair

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
* Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
* Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
* Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
**Job Description - ITI Engineer / Passive Networking Engineer**
**Position:**
ITI Engineer - Passive Networking
  
  
**Experience:**
0-3 Years
  
  
**Qualification:**
ITI / Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Networking or relevant technical trade
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an
**ITI Engineer / Passive Networking Engineer**
to support enterprise networking and infrastructure projects involving
**fiber optic and copper cabling, cable laying, termination, splicing, testing, troubleshooting and data-center infrastructure**
.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have good practical knowledge of passive networking, be comfortable working at customer/project sites and have a strong focus on quality, safety and documentation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Perform fiber optic and copper cable laying as per approved routes and project requirements.
* Conduct route surveys, cable length calculations and pathway/tray inspections.
* Perform fiber splicing, including stripping, cleaning, cleaving, alignment, fusion splicing and splice-tray dressing.
* Perform fiber core mapping, labeling and termination.
* Work with LIU, ODF, fiber cassettes, patch panels and patch cords.
* Perform fiber testing using VFL, optical power meter and OTDR.
* Identify and troubleshoot fiber faults, high-loss issues, connectivity problems and link failures.
* Perform CAT5e/CAT6/CAT6A copper cable laying and termination.
* Perform I/O and patch-panel termination using T568A/T568B standards.
* Ensure proper cable dressing, bend-radius control, labeling and cable management.
* Conduct copper cable testing and support certification activities.
* Troubleshoot failed copper certification results, including wire-map, termination, pair-untwist, bend/crushing and patch-cord issues.
* Support data-center cabling and rack patching activities.
* Maintain accurate Port Matrix, Fiber Core Matrix, Copper Connectivity Sheets and cable documentation.
* Prepare and maintain testing reports, as-built documentation and project handover documents.
* Coordinate with project engineers, customers, vendors and internal teams during implementation.
* Follow all required quality, safety and site procedures.

**Required Technical Skills**
Fiber Optics
  
  

* Basic understanding of Single Mode and Multi Mode Fiber.
* Knowledge of OS1/OS2 and OM1/OM2/OM3/OM4/OM5.
* 12-core fiber color-code knowledge.
* Fiber laying and cable dressing.
* Fusion splicing and core mapping.
* VFL, OTDR and optical power testing.
* Fiber fault identification and troubleshooting.

Copper Cabling
  
  

* CAT5e, CAT6 and CAT6A cabling.
* T568A/T568B color codes.
* I/O and patch-panel termination.
* Cable dressing and labeling.
* Wire-map and certification testing.
* Understanding of NEXT, FEXT, Return Loss and other basic certification parameters.

Data Center / Infrastructure
  
  

* Rack and patch-panel connectivity.
* LIU, ODF and fiber cassette handling.
* Cable routing and management.
* Port mapping and source/destination identification.
* Basic understanding of structured cabling practices.

Candidate Profile
  
  

* ITI / Diploma candidates with relevant technical knowledge are preferred.
* Freshers with practical training in networking/cabling can be considered.
* 0-3 years of experience in passive networking, structured cabling, fiber optics or data-center infrastructure will be an advantage.
* Should be comfortable working at customer/project sites.
* Good troubleshooting and practical problem-solving skills.
* Good understanding of cable identification, labeling and documentation.
* Strong focus on quality and safety.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Willingness to travel to project/customer locations as required.

**Practical Skills Preferred**
Candidates with hands-on exposure to the following will be preferred:
  
  

* Fusion Splicing Machine
* OTDR
* VFL
* Optical Power Meter
* Fiber Cleaver
* Fiber Stripper
* CAT6/CAT6A I/O Termination
* Cable Certification Tester
* Patch Panels
* LIU/ODF
* Rack & Cable Management

Key Competencies
  
  
**Technical Skills | Fiber Splicing | Copper Termination | Cable Laying | OTDR Testing | Troubleshooting | Data Center Cabling | Documentation | Safety | Quality Workmanship**

title: Senior Engineer - ELV & ICT
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
As an ELV & ICT Design Engineer, you'll play a key role in delivering integrated technology and security solutions for complex building projects. You'll work across ICT, telecommunications, security, life safety, and building management systems, helping clients create safer, smarter, and more connected environments.
  
  
In this role, you'll contribute to the design and engineering of systems including Fire Detection & Alarm Systems, Public Address & Voice Alarm Systems, Building Management Systems (BMS), Security Systems, ICT networks, structured cabling infrastructure, and telecommunications networks. Your work will directly influence how buildings are operated, secured, and maintained throughout their lifecycle.
  
  
You'll collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams, supporting the development of system architectures, technical specifications, BIM models, tender documentation, and design deliverables. This is an opportunity to apply your technical expertise across a broad range of ELV and ICT systems while expanding your experience in integrated building technologies, international design standards, and digital design platforms.
  
  
Here's what you'll need
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in ELV & ICT Design. Demonstrated ability to design and engineer ELV, ICT, telecommunications, security, and life safety systems for building projects.

+ Proven capability in designing Fire Detection & Alarm Systems, Public Address & Voice Alarm Systems, Early Warning & Smoke Detection Systems, and Building Management Systems (BMS).
+ Ability to design security solutions including video surveillance, access control, intrusion detection, and perimeter security systems.
+ Experience developing ICT and telecommunications network architectures, including structured cabling, campus backbone infrastructure, IP telephony, wireless networks, and intercom systems.
+ Proficiency in developing ELV and ICT network architectures, including the selection of switches, routers, firewalls, and related network equipment.
+ Ability to perform design calculations and develop cable containment and conduit routing solutions.
+ Working knowledge of relevant Indian and international design codes and standards such as NFPA, IS, NBC, BS, IEEE, BICSI, and TIA.
+ Experience preparing design documentation including technical specifications, datasheets, material requisitions, BOQs, and tender documentation, and reviewing contractor and vendor submissions.
+ Working knowledge of BIM and design tools such as Revit, AutoCAD, BIM 360, and Revizto.
+ Strong collaboration skills with the ability to coordinate across multiple engineering disciplines and evaluate design changes and non-conformances.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

description:
**Role Overview**
**Escalations & Customer Experience Engineering**
The Principal Support Engineer is a senior, hands-on technical expert responsible for driving rapid resolution of complex customer issues. This role blends deep technical troubleshooting, advanced log and API analysis, Datadog monitoring expertise, and leadership of high‑severity escalations. The engineer will collaborate tightly with Engineering, Product, and external vendors to eliminate root causes, improve MTTR, and elevate the overall customer experience.
  
  
This is a high‑visibility individual contributor role requiring strong ownership, urgency, and the ability to translate complex technical problems into clear, actionable paths forward for both customers and internal stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform hands‑on technical troubleshooting using Datadog (logs, traces, dashboards), API tools (Postman/cURL), and distributed log tracing.
* Lead high-severity and strategic customer escalations, providing authoritative technical direction and timely communication.
* Drive vendor ticket escalations, ensuring SLA adherence and proactive follow‑ups with Microsoft, Adobe, AWS, Cisco, and others.
* Collaborate with Engineering to deliver root-cause fixes, submit detailed technical findings, and validate permanent resolutions.
* Partner with Product to identify platform gaps, recurring customer pain points, and areas for workflow or UX improvement.
* Analyze MTTR performance, SLA trends, and operational bottlenecks; publish weekly metrics and insights.
* Develop SOPs, escalation workflows, and troubleshooting guides that improve global support operations.
* Identify automation opportunities and collaborate with internal teams to enhance Zendesk workflows and self-service deflection.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 10+ years in Technical Support Engineering, Escalations, SRE, or related roles.
* Expertise with Datadog (log search, traces, monitors, dashboards).
* Strong REST API troubleshooting using Postman, cURL, authentication flows, and JSON payload analysis.
* Experience diagnosing distributed systems, integrations, and SaaS platform behavior.
* Proven ability to interface with strategic enterprise customers and communicate complex technical issues clearly.
* Hands‑on experience with vendor escalation processes and SLA governance.
* Strong working knowledge of MTTR, incident management, and technical support KPIs.
* Familiarity with Zendesk or similar ticketing platforms.

**Performance Expectations & KPIs**

* Resolve ≥90% of escalated tickets within SLA.
* Engage vendors within 15 minutes of SLA risk detection.
* Drive MTTR improvements of 40–50% for assigned ticket categories.
* Maintain CSAT ≥90% for escalated interactions.
* Identify and support permanent fixes for at least 2 recurring root-cause issues per quarter.
* Deliver 3–5 workflow, automation, or SOP improvements each quarter.
* This is not a complete listing of the job duties. It’s a representation of the things you will be doing, and you may not perform all of these duties.

title: Senior IT Administrator
description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance**
 At CoinDCX, our mission is clear—to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.
   

  

 As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2\.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.
   

  

 We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution, and people who want to build what’s next.
   

  

 If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an IT System Administrator / Senior System Administrator , you'll be the backbone of CoinDCX's internal technology ecosystem, ensuring our employees have a secure, reliable, and seamless IT experience every day.
   

  

 This role goes beyond resolving technical issues—you'll help build scalable IT operations, strengthen endpoint security, streamline identity and access management, and continuously improve how technology enables our teams. If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges while creating long\-term operational excellence, this role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in one of India's fastest\-growing fintech organizations.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own end\-to\-end endpoint support by troubleshooting hardware, software, operating system, and network\-related issues across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices.
* Deliver exceptional L1 IT support by resolving user issues efficiently while ensuring an outstanding employee experience.
* Manage employee onboarding and offboarding by provisioning devices, accounts, application access, and ensuring secure deprovisioning.
* Administer Identity \& Access Management (IAM), MDM platforms, and SaaS applications to maintain secure and compliant user access.
* Drive incident, change, and asset management processes while maintaining accurate documentation, SOPs, and ticketing records.
* Monitor system health, analyze recurring issues, and implement permanent solutions that improve IT reliability and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with internal teams and L2/L3 support to resolve complex technical issues while ensuring timely communication with stakeholders.
* Support network infrastructure, wireless access points, antivirus solutions, and endpoint security initiatives to maintain a secure workplace.


**You'll Excel in This Role If You**
* Think proactively and focus on preventing issues rather than simply resolving them.
* Have a strong ownership mindset and consistently deliver reliable IT support.
* Enjoy troubleshooting complex technical problems across endpoints, operating systems, and networks.
* Communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Are process\-oriented with strong documentation and organizational skills.
* Thrive in fast\-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly.
* Continuously learn new technologies and look for opportunities to automate and improve IT operations.


**What We're Looking For**
* 4 years of experience in IT Infrastructure, IT Support, System Administration, or FinTech IT Operations.
* Strong expertise in Windows, macOS, hardware diagnostics, software troubleshooting, and endpoint management.
* Experience with Employee Onboarding \& Offboarding processes.
* Hands\-on knowledge of Identity \& Access Management (IAM).
* Experience managing Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android.
* Familiarity with SaaS administration including Active Directory, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and related collaboration tools.
* Working knowledge of ticketing platforms such as Jira, ServiceNow, or ManageEngine ServiceDesk.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including LAN, VLAN, IP addressing, OSI model, and wireless access points.
* Knowledge of antivirus solutions, endpoint security, and IT compliance best practices.
* Experience with Incident Management, Change Management, and IT Asset Management.
* IT certifications such as ITIL, MCSA, or MCP will be an added advantage.
* Willingness to travel or relocate based on business requirements.


**You'll Know You're Winning When**
 Within your first six months:
   

  

* Employees experience fast, reliable, and high\-quality IT support with improved resolution times.
* Onboarding and offboarding processes are standardized, secure, and executed with zero operational gaps.
* Endpoint compliance, device management, and identity access processes are consistently maintained.
* Documentation, SOPs, and IT operational processes become more structured and scalable.
* Repeat incidents are reduced through proactive problem management and permanent fixes.
* Internal stakeholders trust the IT team as a reliable business partner.


**Why This Role Matters \& What's In It For You**
 Technology is the foundation that enables every CoinDCX team to innovate at speed. In this role, you'll directly influence the productivity, security, and operational excellence of the organization.
   

  

 You'll work with modern IT infrastructure, SaaS ecosystems, security tools, and enterprise technologies while gaining exposure to one of India's leading Web3 and fintech companies. As CoinDCX continues to scale, you'll have opportunities to grow your technical expertise, contribute to automation initiatives, and build systems that support the future of finance.
   

  

**Hiring Process**
 Here's what your journey with us looks like:
   

  

* Application Review – We assess your skills, experience, and alignment with the role.
* Recruiter Connect – A conversation to understand your background and career aspirations.
* Technical Interview(s) – Deep dive into your IT infrastructure knowledge, troubleshooting approach, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Practical Assessment / Scenario Discussion – Evaluate your ability to diagnose, prioritize, and resolve real\-world IT challenges.
* Culture \& Values Discussion – Understand how you collaborate, communicate, and thrive in fast\-paced environments.
* Leadership Conversation (Optional) – For select candidates, a discussion focused on long\-term growth and strategic alignment.


**Where We Work**
 We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed, and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
   

  

 With this belief, we operate as a work\-from\-office organization. This role is based out of our
 **Mumbai office** 
 , where innovation happens every day through close collaboration and shared ownership.
   

  

**Perks That Empower You**
 We believe great people deserve great experiences.
   

  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to support your lifestyle.
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Take the time you need to rest and recharge.
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources.
* Learning Sessions: Regular learning opportunities to help you grow personally and professionally.


**Ready to Build What's Next?**
 If you're excited about creating reliable technology experiences, solving meaningful technical challenges, and enabling teams to do their best work, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 Join CoinDCX and help us build the technology that powers the future of finance.

description:
**Location:** 
 Mumbai, India (onsite)
 



**Type:** 
 Permanent
 



**Experience:** 
 10 plus years in data centre / infrastructure engineering (trading/HFT experience strongly preferred)
 



  





 About the role
 



 Own the physical and logical infrastructure that powers ultra\-low\-latency trading systems. You'll design, deploy and maintain rack layouts, structured cabling, servers and network hardware across primary data centres and colocation sites—working closely with network, systems and trading\-technology teams.
 



 This is a hands\-on role where clean builds, precise documentation and fast, safe changes directly impact trading performance and resilience.
 



  





 What you'll do
 


* Design and implement low\-latency data centre infrastructure: rack layouts, power, cooling, cable paths and connectivity plans.
* Perform rack\-and\-stack of servers, switches, trading appliances and specialist hardware; manage asset lifecycles.
* Install, test and maintain structured cabling (fibre and copper): LC/MPO/MTP, patch panels, transceivers, SFPs/QSFPs.
* Configure and support high\-speed network hardware (10/25/40/100GbE\+) from vendors such as Arista, Cisco, Juniper, Mellanox/NVIDIA.
* Work with Linux server hardware and remote management (iLO, iDRAC, IPMI); perform firmware/BIOS/BMC updates and hardware diagnostics.



  





 What we're looking for
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics/Telecommunications or related field (or equivalent hands\-on experience).
* Hands\-on data centre experience in latency\-sensitive environments (trading/HFT, exchanges, financial infrastructure).
* Strong knowledge of data centre design: power distribution, redundancy, rack capacity, environmental considerations and best practices.
* Proven experience with structured cabling: fibre (LC, MPO, MTP) and copper (Cat6/Cat6a), cable dressing and management.

 Assistant Vice President (Data Center Automation)
 



  





 Role Summary
 



  





 The Assistant Vice President of Data Center Automation is a senior leadership role responsible for driving the automation, optimization, and security of data center operations. This position oversees Building Management System (BMS) operations, and OSS/BSS (Operational Support Systems/Business Support Systems) functions, ensuring seamless integration, efficiency, and resilience across all systems. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background, strategic vision, and proven experience in managing large\-scale data center and telecom/IT service environments.
 



  





 Technical Scope of Work
 



 System Architecture \& Design
 



 Define and document the overall control architecture, including:
 



 PLC/DDC network hierarchy and supervisory levels.
 



 OT LAN segmentation, VLAN design, and IP plan.
 



 Redundancy and failover logic for automation systems.
 



 Develop IO lists, control philosophy documents and functional design specifications (FDS).
 



 Coordinate between MEP consultants, controls contractors, and operations to align automation design.
 



 Control System Development \- Must
 



 Author control sequence logic for:
 



 Power systems: Need to have good understanding of the capacity framework and working design of UPS, LV/MV switchgear, gensets, fuel systems, PDUs
 



  





 Cooling systems: Need to have good understanding of the capacity framework and working design of chillers, CRAHs, pumps, valves, cooling towers, heat exchangers.
 



 Configure and validate PLCs, DDCs, and SCADA servers (Schneider / Siemens / Rockwell / Honeywell).
 



 Standardize data points and naming conventions across all systems.
 



 Implement interoperability via BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP/IP, OPC\-UA, and MQTT brokers for telemetry aggregation
 



  





 Commissioning \& Validation
 



 Develop FAT/SAT scripts for validation of control logic, redundancy, and failover scenarios.
 



 Execute alarm and trend validation to ensure full functional coverage.
 



 Oversee integration testing with DCIM, AIops, or energy optimization platforms.
 



  





 OT \& Cybersecurity Governance
 



 Define the OT framework for automation systems, including:
 



 Network segregation between IT and OT.
 



 Firewall and DMZ policy enforcement.
 



 Patch management and backup strategy for controllers and servers.
 



 Align systems to IEC 62443 or equivalent cybersecurity compliance framework.
 



 Operations Enablement \- Must
 



 Create O\&M procedures for BMS / SCADA systems including:
 



 Change management and version control.
 



 Alarm rationalization and escalation protocols.
 



 Data historian configuration and retention policies.
 



 Develop automation analytics dashboards to track PUE, thermal KPIs, and predictive maintenance metrics.
 



 Maintain system access logs, firmware inventories, and security posture reports
 



 Continuous Optimization \- Must
 



 Collaborate with design and operations teams to:
 



 Tune PID loops and optimize control setpoints.
 



 Integrate AI models for predictive control.
 



 Support digital twin deployment and data validation
 



  





 Contract and Stakeholder Management
 



 Manage relationships with technology vendors, service providers, and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless operations and project execution.
 



 Negotiate contracts and oversee service\-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high standards of performance.
 



  





 At BDx, we believe that our success lies in the hands of our talented and dedicated employees. Together, we are shaping the future of the data center industry and making a positive impact on the world.

title: Network Engineer
description:
Low Latency Network Engineer (Trading Infrastructure)
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai
 



**Type:** 
 Permanent
 



**Experience:** 
 10 plus years in network/infrastructure engineering (trading/HFT experience strongly preferred)
 



  





 Design, build and support the high\-performance network that powers a proprietary trading firm's global strategy. You'll work on ultra\-low\-latency LAN/WAN, multicast market\-data distribution and exchange connectivity across colocation data centres, with a heavy focus on performance, resilience and automation. This role sits at the core of the trading platform—close to traders, developers and infrastructure teams—where microsecond\-level improvements matter.
 



  





 What you'll do
 


* Design, implement and maintain low\-latency network infrastructure for trading applications (Arista/Cisco, leaf–spine, bare\-metal servers).
* Configure and tune Layer 2/3 protocols: BGP, OSPF, VRF, PIM/IGMP, multicast, QoS, STP, NAT.
* Support exchange connectivity, cross\-connects and colocation deployments; work with carriers and data\-centre teams.
* Troubleshoot latency, jitter, packet loss and microbursts using tcpdump, Wireshark, NIC stats and switch telemetry.
* Automate network changes and validations using Python, Bash and/or Ansible; contribute to IaC and CI/CD pipelines.
* Monitor network health and performance; create dashboards and alerts for proactive incident management.



  





 What we're looking for
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics/Telecommunications or related field.
* 10 plus years of hands\-on networking experience, ideally in HFT, prop trading, exchanges or other latency\-sensitive environments.
* Deep knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, multicast, routing (BGP/OSPF), switching, VLANs and data\-centre networking.
* Practical experience with Arista and/or Cisco NX\-OS in production trading or financial\-services environments.
* Strong Linux networking fundamentals; comfortable working in a terminal and with performance tooling.
* Proven troubleshooting skills for low\-latency issues (packet captures, NIC/driver tuning, switch buffers, PTP/NTP).

title: Solutions Architect - IIOT
description:
About the Role
 
  





 We are looking for an experienced IoT Solutions Architect with strong hands\-on background in Industrial IoT (IIoT) to design, architect, and lead end\-to\-end implementation of IoT solutions across manufacturing, energy, utilities, or other industrial environments. This role requires someone who has not just designed architectures on paper but has actually built, deployed, and supported IIoT solutions in real production/plant environments.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities
 
  





 •       Design end\-to\-end IoT/IIoT architecture — from edge devices, sensors, and gateways to cloud platforms, data pipelines, and analytics/visualization layers.
 



 •       Lead technical implementation of IIoT projects including device connectivity (OPC\-UA, Modbus, MQTT, PROFINET, LoRaWAN), edge computing, and integration with SCADA/PLC/DCS/MES systems.
 



 •       Define data ingestion, storage, and processing architecture (time\-series DBs, stream processing, digital twin frameworks).
 



 •       Select and integrate appropriate IoT platforms (AWS IoT, Azure IoT Hub, GCP IoT, PTC ThingWorx, Siemens MindSphere, etc.) based on client/business needs.
 



 •       Own solution architecture from PoC to production rollout, including scalability, security, and reliability considerations.
 



 •       Collaborate with OT/IT teams to bridge industrial systems with enterprise IT and cloud infrastructure.
 



 •       Define and implement IoT security architecture — device authentication, data encryption, network segmentation (IT/OT security).
 



 •       Create technical documentation: architecture diagrams, solution blueprints, deployment guides, and SOPs.
 



 •       Work closely with sales/pre\-sales teams for solutioning, technical proposals, and client presentations.
 



 •       Design and deploy LoRaWAN\-based sensor networks, including gateway placement, network server configuration, and device provisioning.
 



 •       Troubleshoot and resolve architecture\-level issues during deployment and post\-production support.
 



  




 Required Skills \& Experience
 
  





 •       4–5 years in IoT/embedded systems/industrial automation, with hands\-on experience in IIoT solution architecture and implementation.
 



 •       Proven experience implementing (not just designing) IIoT solutions — device onboarding, edge deployment, cloud integration, dashboarding.
 



 •       Strong knowledge of industrial protocols: OPC\-UA, Modbus, MQTT, PROFINET, BACnet, etc.
 



 •       Hands\-on experience with LoRaWAN technologies — network architecture, gateway/end\-node deployment, network server platforms (e.g., The Things Stack, ChirpStack), and LoRaWAN device integration.
 



 •       Hands\-on experience with one or more IoT/cloud platforms: AWS IoT Core/Greengrass, Azure IoT Hub/Edge, GCP Cloud IoT, PTC ThingWorx, Siemens MindSphere, Litmus, or similar.
 



 •       Experience with edge computing devices/gateways (e.g., Dell Edge Gateways, Advantech, Siemens IoT2050, Raspberry Pi/industrial variants).
 



 •       Understanding of SCADA, PLC, DCS, MES, and OT network architecture.
 



 •       Experience with time\-series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB) and data visualization tools (Grafana, Power BI).
 



 •       Knowledge of containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) for edge/cloud deployments.
 



 •       Familiarity with IoT security best practices (device identity, PKI, network segmentation).
 



 •       Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, Node.js, or similar) for automation and integration work.
 



 •       Experience working directly at customer/plant sites for deployment, commissioning, and troubleshooting is a strong plus.
 



  




 Preferred Qualifications
 
 •       Certifications such as AWS/Azure IoT specialty, CSSA, or relevant OT security certifications.
 



 •       Experience with digital twin implementations.
 



 •       Exposure to predictive maintenance / condition monitoring use cases.
 



 •       Prior experience in manufacturing, energy, utilities, or process industries.
 



  




 Education
 * •       B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Computer Science, Instrumentation, or related field (M.Tech/MS preferred but not mandatory).

title: Manager, IT Infrastructure & Operations (Individual Contributor)
description:
TRYST is a research\-to\-translation institution on the IIT Bombay campus, working across semiconductors, AI, health and bio, energy and clean technology, and related verticals. It is building the digital and IT environment for a multi\-Centre organisation that is expected to scale toward 1,000\+ people, while remaining on campus and partnering with IIT Bombay shared services.
 



 This is a founding IT role: the opportunity to design and run the function, not to inherit one.
 



  





**JOB PURPOSE** 




 Own TRYST’s IT infrastructure and day\-to\-day IT operations — identity and endpoint operations on Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, TRYST cloud and overlay connectivity, devices, backups, and first\-line service.
 



 Build the function from a standing start: standards, vendors, assets and the first hires. Do the work yourself until there is a team. Coordinate campus network, licensed software and journal access with the IIT Bombay Computing Centre rather than recreating those services. Grow the role into Head of Infrastructure as TRYST scales.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 Note : It's an Individual Contributor role initially and based on Org. requirements , the team can be aligned later.
 



**Infrastructure, cloud and campus overlay** 



* Design, implement and operate TRYST\-owned infrastructure: Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, the endpoint estate, file and backup services, TRYST cloud (Azure as the starting tenancy), and overlay connectivity on the campus network.
* Partner with the IIT Bombay Computing Centre on campus LAN/Wi\-Fi, research computing, and software / journal catalogues. Own the TRYST overlay, the join path for a new employee, and the escalation path to Computing Centre.
* Set infrastructure standards and runbooks that will still hold as TRYST grows across Centres and toward 1,000\+ people, on a common identity and device baseline.
* Plan capacity, backup and disaster recovery for TRYST\-owned systems. Campus backbone DR remains with Computing Centre.



**Identity, endpoint and security operations** 



* Operate Microsoft 365 / Entra ID as TRYST’s directory: account hygiene, groups, MFA, conditional access, privileged access, and the joiner / mover / leaver path from the HR system (Keka).
* Own endpoint management and protection (Intune or equivalent, disk encryption, patching and baseline hardening). TRYST handles research IP; unmanaged devices are not the default.
* Own infrastructure security for TRYST\-run systems: access, backups, incident first\-response, and the first set of IT security policies with the CEO.
* Keep security usable. Default access should follow the employee’s role; exceptions should be the minority.



**Service delivery** 



* Provide IT support until a dedicated service desk exists: provisioning, workstation and access issues, with a published response target.
* Establish a single, simple request channel and evolve it as headcount grows.
* Support lab, compute and connectivity needs of research Centres, escalating specialised research computing to Computing Centre or an agreed cloud pattern.



**Vendors, assets and budget** 



* Own vendor relationships for devices, connectivity overlays, cloud, endpoint security and any managed\-service overflow.
* Maintain the IT asset register and lifecycle — issue, recover, wipe and recycle — tied to joining and leaving.
* Manage the infrastructure and endpoint budget and provide actuals for TRYST IT cost planning.



**Team and operating model** 



* Hire, coach and oversee the first support and infrastructure engineers as workload justifies it.
* Clarify ownership between TRYST IT, HR, Finance and Computing Centre, including where a service is TRYST\-owned, outsourced, or provided by IIT Bombay.
* Leave the organisation able to add a Head of IT, an applications lead and a security lead as TRYST scales, without rewiring this job.



**EXPERIENCE** 




**Required** 




 8–12 years in IT infrastructure, systems, network or workplace/endpoint engineering, with end\-to\-end ownership rather than ticket\-only support.
 



 • Hands\-on with cloud identity and modern workplace (Microsoft 365 / Entra ID or a close equivalent): directory, MFA and device management — not only on\-premises Active Directory.
 



 • Experience designing and operating network, server/cloud and backup/disaster\-recovery environments.
 



 • Vendor, contract and budget management. Experience hiring or coaching at least one engineer.
 



 • Comfortable remaining hands\-on — imaging a laptop, resolving connectivity issues, supporting a joiner — as well as designing the environment.
 



**Preferred** 




 Built infrastructure for a growing organisation rather than only running a mature one.
 



 • Campus, academic, research\-lab or institutional environments, especially coordinating with a central computing or network group you do not control.
 



 • Identity lifecycle (joiner, mover, leaver) with an HR system such as Keka.
 



 • Familiarity with Indian vendor and procurement practice, and with Mumbai / IIT campus context.
 



  





**WHAT WE LOOK FOR** 



* High tolerance for ambiguity: standards will be written here, not inherited.
* Judgement that balances security, reliability and pace — research IP on one side, an early\-stage timetable on the other.
* Credibility with scientists, operators and vendors, and the ability to hold a single TRYST IT stack rather than parallel Centre\-level ones.
* A bias to hands\-on execution in the first year, with the systems thinking so the second year is not a rewrite.



**REMUNERATION** 




**Level** 




 Manager.
 



**Compensation** 




 Competitive and commensurate with experience

description:

**AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security – Staff**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security Staff professional with solution mindset, who understands \& possess knowledge in network security / Infrastructure security concepts, risk and controls concepts, architecture design, transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a staff professional who should have practical experience in network security engineering, detection engineering, and OT cyber risk reduction, with growing exposure to AI\-assisted security operations, prompt engineering, AI\-driven anomaly detection, and device behavior analytics.
   

  

 This role is part of the Cyber Frontier \& AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI\-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Understands design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443\-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Possess knowledge about deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE, DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Incident response and security improvement initiatives to enhance cyber resilience across hybrid infrastructure.
* Possess knowledge \& experience on secure remote access, DMZ architecture, PLC security, and cloud network protection.
* Good understanding on AI\-assisted IT/OT security architecture and operations, enabling predictive threat monitoring and automated response within industrial environments.
* Understands AI\-driven anomaly detection models to identify deviations in OT network traffic, process behaviors, and industrial protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, OPC).
* Build AI\-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.
* Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.
* Implement AI\-powered device behavior profiling, establishing baselines for PLCs, HMIs, and IoT/IIoT assets to detect unauthorized or abnormal activities.
* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
* Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero\-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI\-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network \& Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 1–3 years of experience across AI driven Network \& Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.


**Professional understanding \& knowledge of\-**
* OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
* XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong interpersonal and customer orientation skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Knowledge of Information security standards and compliances (ISO 27001, ISO 27017, NIST 800 53, NIST 800\-207, CISA, CIS benchmark etc)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network \& infra structure security portfolio in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network \& infrastructure security practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.

 The
 **Ticket Readiness SME / Coordinator**
